pass_2.finding: The InGex small-RNA protocol starts TGIRT from a 41-nt RNA/42-nt DNA duplex with one-base DNA 3′ overhang in 450 mM NaCl and then circles cDNA. additional_passes.finding: TGIRT50.pdf and TGIRT10.pdf are identical 5-page InGex Small RNA/CircLigase instructions, dated 23 January 2017. The catalog-name file does not supply a separate TGIRT50 enzyme datasheet or the authors’ lot/revision. additional_passes.locations: Full mim-tRNAseq source-bundle scraper completed first (29 hits, including TGIRT50.pdf.txt lines 57–62). Independently read original InGex TGIRT50.pdf text lines 1–45, 49–65, 72–140 and original Behrens 2021 JATS Results lines 82–84 and STAR Methods lines 278, 390–410. Compared the two downloaded original PDFs using cmp and MD5: /husky/henriksson/NGS101_papers/sources/mim-trnaseq__10.1016+j.molcel.2021.01.028/TGIRT50.pdf and /tmp/TGIRT10.pdf, each 182799 bytes, MD5 4ca4abd4a8e6ef898670ea8d2cac9051.
additional_passes.finding: The TGIRT50- and TGIRT10-named PDFs are byte-for-byte identical; both are the five-page InGex Small RNA/CircLigase protocol last updated 2017-01-23. That vendor method initiates with a blocked 41-nt RNA/42-nt DNA starter duplex with one-nucleotide DNA 3-prime overhang in 450 mM NaCl, then uses CircLigase II. The mim-tRNAseq defining workflow instead ligates a 5-prime-phosphorylated/3-prime-ddC DNA adapter to tRNA, anneals a distinct primer-dependent RT oligo, and uses 75 mM KCl at 42 C for its optimized branch; its cDNA is later circularized with CircLigase ssDNA ligase. The vendor PDF is an original method but cannot source the mim primer-dependent initiation or show which TGIRT50 enzyme lot/revision the authors used. Exclusion from evidence for mim-specific RT chemistry is warranted; the shared enzyme and later circularization do not imply the same reaction.
